decision_conditions: Uses within Class D1 and D2
site_name:
Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area
North West London
description: Reserved Matters Application in respect of Plot 22 within Phase 5E, pursuant to Condition 1.3(v) and Condition 2.1 attached to planning permission F/04687/13 for the comprehensive mixed use redevelopment of the Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area. The application seeks approval for details relating to layout, scale, appearance, access and landscaping for the residential led mixed use development for Plot 22, which will be one building (3 blocks) ranging from 8 to 14 storeys, to provide 148 specialist older persons housing units including associated communal facilities (Use Class C2); flexible retail/leisure use (A1/A2/D1/D2 Use) at ground level; and car parking, cycle parking and refuse storage space at ground and basement levels. Application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement of Compliance.
